title: Which nearby cells need a look?
hook: A point across a cell boundary may still be close.

knows: Cartesian coordinates and Euclidean distance where geometry is used; integer counts/sets as explicitly drawn.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish grid candidates from exact radius neighbours and relate cell size to search offsets.

objective: Distinguish grid candidates from exact radius neighbours and relate cell size to search offsets.
misconception: Checking the eight adjacent cells always finds every radius neighbour, regardless of cell width.
